title: HelixBenchmarkExecutionRecord
description: Standard execution record schema for Helix head-to-head benchmark runs

run_id.description: Unique identifier for this benchmark execution

mode.description: Execution arm: unharnessed baseline agent or Helix-harnessed agent

model_version.description: Exact model checkpoint or snapshot identifier if available

repository_commit.description: Git commit SHA of the repository snapshot evaluated

started_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when task execution commenced

finished_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when task execution and grading completed

success.description: Whether the run satisfied mechanical acceptance criteria and passed tests

total_tokens.description: Sum of input, output, and reasoning tokens

estimated_cost_usd.description: Estimated monetary cost in USD based on model pricing table, or null if unmeasured

retries.description: Number of retry iterations attempted after test or lint failure

files_changed.description: Count of modified, created, or deleted files in the working tree

error.description: Failure error message or null if run succeeded
